statements.status_notes: Backport of the upstream GStreamer fix (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/d665ae87967ccd6dea0375f9c71a8d8270d9f9d6) that sizes ASF string tag values as UTF-16LE, so characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane no longer cause a heap out-of-bounds write in the ASF muxer. Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-100231.

Backport of the upstream GStreamer fix (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/89efe32eac678d3e0bc4b28a9c7acd02728e5337) that requires three payload bytes before reading the CDP size of an MXF VANC element, so the demuxer no longer reads past the end of a short payload. The other upstream changes (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/209fb634cfcd2776073c0ea3264009321d04ab65 and the remaining hunks of the commit above) rework ST 2038 conversion and writer code that is not present in this release, and the 1.26.2 writer allocates the exact size of each packet. Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-125703.

Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-100231.

Backport upstream GStreamer fixes validating MXF delta entry ids and slice indexes before use (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/b03b7449c0eee8459a33f0c8309146327f43a796, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/6bbc7ec1497d10efc1c3aed44a67d662ce82d7ba, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/048d5c291a3173270fdf7dd81e708a142cd7b129, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/6b4bfe2ad0576abae38116fca3ffb00a7fb99b84). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-121601.

Backport upstream GStreamer fix adding the upper bounds check for the MXF reverse temporal offsets array (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/53677b5c176f653014a6d164bd585d2815839e8d). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-125707.

Backport upstream GStreamer fix initializing H.265 HRD parameters before use in the VPS parser (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/29fba4dc5606554e391a616bbc51943ad4c8e46f). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-121611.

Backport upstream GStreamer fixes adding missing bounds checks to MPEG program stream PES header parsing (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/018c476c9076c76c8d64e862a211cbafb34727fb, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/495e9cbed7943587ea31dcb7d30c9475b7e3cfc1, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/234ad3c4f2e73048c61849ea553907580fe46bf8). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-125706.

Backport upstream GStreamer fixes adding integer overflow and division by zero guards to the JPEG 2000 decimator codestream parser (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/f9cc731607ca60ce8a66e0ded3a11d77805d55c6, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/e900fe1730353b068b9224dcde331b62ee58d27c). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-121259.

Backport upstream GStreamer fix using guint64 accumulation for AV1 LEB128 parsing in gstav1parser and gstav1parse (GStreamer-SA-2026-0014, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/845e9cf7d12da539ee9f4a8e5ce4ce880485c6c2). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119729.

Backport upstream GStreamer fix guarding NULL pointers when freeing partially parsed H.264 MVC SPS data (GStreamer-SA-2026-0013, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/1f823ee39f253fc23ad95e6833281146cad8ecad). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119728.

Backport upstream GStreamer fix capping H.265 pic_timing num_decoding_units_minus1 (GStreamer-SA-2026-0012, https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/7e717afe9839b05c350b6778811eef5e4c75bb26). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119727.

Backport upstream GStreamer fix widening the H.266 profile/tier/level loop counter to avoid integer overflow on malformed bitstreams (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/gstreamer/gstreamer/-/commit/c2690afec214d86ea5c054ca689fb7ee36980c45). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119777.

The H.266 DCI parser API (gst_h266_parser_parse_dci) is compiled into libgstcodecparsers but has no call sites anywhere in gst-plugins-bad 1.26.2; no shipped plugin or element invokes it. Debian and the CVE description state that no standard GStreamer pipeline element uses this path (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-100229).

Backport upstream GStreamer 1.28.5 pcapparse fix adding IPv4/TCP/UDP header bounds checks so malformed PCAP records cannot read past buffer limits (GStreamer-SA-2026-0045). Debian trixie 1.26.2-3+deb13u3 remains unfixed; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-52721.
